name: @wigolo/studio-mcp-contract
description: The studio_* MCP wire contract: the ten input schemas, the tool-name set, and a conformance suite any Studio implementation must pass over its real MCP endpoint.
//not-a-workspace: Deliberately outside the root `workspaces` globs. It declares no dependencies of its own — it uses the repo's vitest, playwright and node types, which resolve upward — so making it a workspace would buy nothing and change install topology for every contributor. Invoke it with `npm run <script> --prefix contracts/studio-mcp`, or from the repo root as `npm run typecheck:contract` and `vitest run --project contract`.
